create_language_pair_dataset: create a LanguagePairDataset wrapping source and target datasets with vocabulary dictionaries for machine translation
collate_samples_into_batch: collate a list of source-target sample dicts into a padded mini-batch tensor ready for model input
compute_alignment_weights: compute inverse-frequency alignment weights from a source-target index tensor for attention training
filter_indices_by_size: filter dataset sample indices by maximum source and target sequence length constraints
get_ordered_indices: get an ordered list of dataset indices sorted by target then source length for efficient batching
